content:
```python
import pandas as pd

df = pd.DataFrame({
    "city": ["A", "B", "A", "C", "B", "A"],
    "month": [1, 1, 2, 2, 3, 3],
    "sales": [10, 20, 30, 40, 50, 60],
})

pivoted = df.pivot_table(
    values="sales",
    index="month",
    columns="city",
    aggfunc="sum",
    fill_value=0,
    observed=True,
)
pivoted["total"] = pivoted.sum(axis=1)

print(pivoted)
```

Output:

```

month                        
1      10   20   0     30
2      30   40   0     70
3      60   50   0     110
```
